text: Instead, it is important to underline at the end of this scheme: it's not one additional feature. We are essentially done with the main features of this scheme, but this is an observation, a reflection of on this enhanced distributed channel access scheme, which is indeed important. So remember what we said: that previously a transmitter that had the opportunity to transmit had the chance to transmit only one packet, right? And then if he had more packets, he had to recontend for the channel and try to access the channel again. So that was a pair packet channel access. Now we already said that thanks to this transmission opportunity innovation, what a transmitter wins is the possibility to transmit for a certain period of time. So we have a temporal channel access scheme, temporal opportunity channel access. As a consequence, the fairness of our distributed channel access scheme changes from the so-called pair packet fairness to the so-called temporal fairness. Now you know what fairness means to be fair. To be fair in English means to give the same possibilities, chances to everyone, right? As we said, Wi-Fi in the distributed channel.
